section: National Bank of Canada: Montreal headquarters standardized on Microsoft Teams Rooms with AVI-SPL Canada
body:
National Bank of Canada brought in AVI-SPL Canada to upgrade the collaboration technology at National Bank Place, its headquarters in downtown Montreal. This brief covers the organization, the need, why AVI-SPL Canada was chosen and the meeting-room standard adopted.

**The organization**
- The page describes National Bank of Canada as Canada's sixth-largest bank and the leading bank in Quebec, serving individuals, businesses and clients at home and internationally since 1859.
- In 2018 the bank set out to build National Bank Place as a space where employees, clients and the local business community could collaborate.
- The building has floor-to-ceiling windows and a large lobby with video walls, digital displays, audio equipment and art. It also has auditoriums, a cafeteria, a wellness center, huddle spaces, large conference rooms and multi-purpose common areas.
- Manuel Vallée Léger, Experience Leader, Physical Workplace at National Bank, said the building was designed with a hybrid work model in mind. The page says this approach helped headquarters staff grow from 8,000 to 11,000.

**The need**
- Changing AV/UC technology and user needs meant the collaboration infrastructure had to be upgraded.
- In 2022 the bank looked for third-party help to optimize forty floors of meeting spaces, along with the lobby, auditoriums, wellness space and cafeteria.

**Why AVI-SPL Canada was chosen**
- AV and unified communications design and deployment expertise.
- An AV solution balancing innovation with ease of use and scalability.
- Global reach: able to serve the Canadian, New York and London offices.
- Corporate social responsibility commitments.
- Bilingual support.

Maxime Migneault, AV Solutions Integrator at National Bank, said the early meetings were productive and quickly produced a plan with each stakeholder's role defined, so the conference-room deployment could be fitted in with the general contractor and other stakeholders.

**The meeting-room standard**
- Employees had got used to Microsoft Teams while working remotely, and the bank wanted a smooth move to the new building with consistent, easy hybrid meetings. It made Microsoft Teams Rooms its primary design for meeting spaces.
- AVI-SPL Canada's proposal was a custom AV solution for Microsoft Teams Rooms with HP Poly cameras, Samsung displays and soundbars. One sentence on the page names the soundbars as Nureva.
- The HP Poly cameras adjust to presenters automatically in real time.
- The page describes the result as a consistent hybrid meeting experience that can evolve as new technologies appear, and says standardizing helped collaboration across the bank's offices in Canada and abroad.
- Léger said the bank reached a high adoption rate, which it counted as mission accomplished, and that the rooms met users' expectations.
- The page's solution list names Biamp, Bose, Epson, HP | Poly, Legrand AV, Microsoft Teams, Peerless-AV, Q-SYS, Samsung and Sennheiser.

**When to use this**
For questions about a financial-services headquarters standardizing on Microsoft Teams Rooms, or why a customer chose AVI-SPL for a large new-build project.

**Not stated in this source**
No adoption-rate figure, prices or per-room equipment quantities.
